items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I think Joe Turner was with Adelaide at that time. ... I mean at one time she had Art and Joe at the same time, didn't she...

ctx.x: *Mayo Williams was the recording director for seven selections Smith recorded, January 14-15, 1929; Smith recorded "Pine Top's Boogie-Woogie" on December 29, 1928.

Shreveport is where I first met Lannie Scott and met George Lewis and...let's see...Professor Campbell had the band, in the Star Theater in Shreveport. And from Shreveport we went to Mobile, Alabama. And all the time, Danny, each week we were meeting different people. Different shows of 20 people, or 30 people or 10 people, you know, like that. When we got to Louisville, that's when I first met Art Tatum. And then you had Cow Cow Davenport, you had many of those guys, you know, of that day. But Art and I became…
